in_marathi.name: Manvrita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manvrita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one whose mind's desire is fulfilled by the divine. In Hindu mythology, Manvrita is the name of a celestial nymph who was blessed by Lord Shiva to have her desires granted.

in_bengali.name: Manvrita
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Mind's desire
in_bengali.long_meaning: Manvrita একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one whose mind's desire is fulfilled by the divine. In Hindu mythology, Manvrita is the name of a celestial nymph who was blessed by Lord Shiva to have her desires granted.
